definitions: The theory that economic benefits provided to businesses and the wealthy will indirectly benefit poorer members of society by creating jobs and stimulating the economy.
A situation where benefits or changes experienced by one group gradually extend to others.
examples: Proponents argue for the trickle-down effect.
Critics question the effectiveness of the trickle-down effect.
The policy aimed to create a trickle-down effect.
There was no significant trickle-down effect observed.
